__title: MyWorkLog vs. Zubido vs. Azubiheft vs. BLok: comparison
__metaDescription: Four digital report books for apprentices side by side: cost, use without an employer, offline, data location, time tracking, trainer approval, AI. Backed by the providers’ own statements, as of 18 September 2026.
__ogTitle: MyWorkLog vs. Zubido vs. Azubiheft vs. BLok
__ogDescription: Four digital report books side by side — using only what the providers state themselves.
app.myworklog_zubido_azubiheft_und_blok: MyWorkLog, Zubido, Azubiheft and BLok compared
app.vier_werkzeuge_die_dasselbe_papierhe: Four tools that replace the same paper report book — and differ in who pays, where the data lives and whether an employer has to take part. The table lists only what the providers state on their own pages. Where a statement is missing, it says so.

app.ab_dem_ersten_verbundenen_azubi: from the first linked apprentice, 30-day trial
app.im_ihklizenzmodell_je_nach_ihk: under the IHK licence model, depends on the chamber
app.7995_einrichtung_12_je_azubi: €79.95 setup + €12 per apprentice per training year
app.planungs_und_checklistenmodul_extra_: planning and checklist modules extra, 4-week trial

app.wer_heute_das_berichtsheft_im: If you keep your report book in the IHK service portal today:
app.laut_den_umstellungshinweisen_von_az: According to Azubiheft’s migration notes, that application will no longer be available from 1 January 2027, and entries must be saved as PDF beforehand. Which successor applies is decided by your chamber.
app.die_tabelle_hat_keinen_sieger: The table has no winner, because the question is not the same for everyone. Four situations where the answer is fairly clear:
app.die_kammer_deines_betriebs_hat: Your employer’s chamber has licensed BLok
app.dann_ist_blok_fuer_dich: Then BLok is free for you, your employer is already registered, and the vocational school can follow along. Another tool only pays off if you also want to track your working hours.
app.der_betrieb_will_rahmenplan_lernquiz: Your employer wants framework plan, learning quiz and messenger in one app
app.das_ist_zubidos_paket_und: That is Zubido’s package, and the employer pays per apprentice. It stays free for you, also in solo mode without an employer.
app.deine_ihk_stellt_auf_azubiheft: Your IHK is switching to Azubiheft
app.dann_bekommst_du_die_konditionen: Then you get your chamber’s terms and a trainer who already approves there. The data sits in a Frankfurt data centre.
app.du_willst_berichtsheft_und_arbeitsze: You want report book and working hours together, without an account
app.dann_ist_myworklog_gebaut_fuer: Then MyWorkLog is built for you: hours, flextime and report book on your device, offline, and your trainer can still approve if you both want that. What is missing is in the table: no built-in framework plan, no vocational-school role.
app.warum_steht_bei_manchen_feldern: Why do some cells say “not mentioned” instead of “no”?
app.weil_nur_zaehlt_was_der: Because only what the provider writes itself counts. A feature that is not on the page may still exist — we do not claim its absence. “No” appears only where the provider’s site documents it, for example BLok, whose account requires a registered company.
app.ist_myworklog_auch_fuer_betriebe: Is MyWorkLog free for employers too?
app.ja_es_gibt_keine_tarife: Yes. There are no plans. The trainer creates an account, links up with the apprentice and approves weeks — with a digital signature, without an invoice. The source code is open under the MIT licence.
app.erkennt_die_ihk_ein_berichtsheft: Will the IHK accept a report book from MyWorkLog?
app.ob_ein_heft_elektronisch_gefuehrt: Whether a report book may be kept electronically is set in the training contract. For the examination, chambers usually ask for a PDF; MyWorkLog produces it on the form of your IHK. When in doubt, ask your chamber — that applies to all four tools.
app.kann_ich_meine_eintraege_von: Can I bring my entries over from one of the other providers?
app.arbeitszeiten_ja_als_excel_oder: Working hours yes, as Excel or CSV. Report-book texts come out of all three as PDF, which cannot be read in automatically. What works is described on the page
app.die_vier_hier_sind_die: These four are the ones people search for most. There are many sector apps from individual associations and chambers; if one is missing, write to info@myworklog.de — criterion and evidence as above, and it gets added.
app.jede_zelle_geht_auf_eine: Every cell traces back to a public page of the provider, linked below, read on 18 September 2026. Quotations are in quotation marks. If a provider changes its information, the table is out of date until the next check — a note to info@myworklog.de is enough.
